headline: Expiry‑day trades are hurting your results

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The expiry‑day slice accounted for a loss of ₹1,16,891, which is the cost of this behaviour. In the 90 expiry‑day trades the net result was a loss of ₹1,16,891, an average loss of ₹1,299 per trade, a win rate of 29% and an average return loss of a 28% loss, while the remaining 124 trades showed a smaller average loss of ₹449, a win rate of 37% and an average return loss of a 5% loss.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule to limit expiry‑day trades before the open in the next review period.
